# Interlace Design System — component registry

> 137 installable React components served over the shadcn registry protocol. Every item publishes its contract — the React Server Component boundary, a declared minimum viewport, the keyboard path, the state union it models, and its own semver — so a machine can choose a component on facts instead of on a screenshot.

Install copies source into the consumer tree; there is no runtime package to depend on. MIT. Built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Install

```bash
# any item, by absolute URL — always works
npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button.json

# the CSS baseline every component assumes (pulled automatically as a
# registry dependency, but install it first for a bare project)
npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme.json
```

The `@interlace/<name>` short form also works, but only after the namespace is registered in the consumer's `components.json`. Prefer the absolute URL in generated instructions.

## Machine-readable index

- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/agent-index.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/agent-index.json): every item with its full contract — tier, rendering boundary, minViewport, keyboard evidence, state unions, ARIA, exports, versions, dependency graph and install command. Start here; it is the only file that lets you FILTER.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/r/registry.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/r/registry.json): the shadcn registry index (the format the CLI reads).
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/r/{name}.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button.json): one shadcn registry item — full file contents, targets, dependencies.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): what an agent can do here, as skills.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/story-map.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/story-map.json): item → Storybook story ids, for a live render of any documented state.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/changelog.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/changelog.json): release history, per component.

## How to choose a component

Filter `agent-index.json` on the contract, not on the name. The fields that decide whether an item can be used at all:

- `meta.tier` — Which DS layer the item belongs to: theme, lib, primitive, pattern, template, effects, charts. Composition runs upward only — a primitive never imports a pattern.
- `meta.client` — true when the installed file carries the "use client" directive. false means it is safe inside a React Server Component with no boundary.
- `meta.minViewport` — The narrowest viewport in CSS px this component is designed to render correctly at, declared in source as `export const MIN_VIEWPORT`. null means it inherits the min-viewport of whatever it renders and introduces no floor of its own.
- `meta.loading` — true when the component accepts `loading?: boolean` and renders its own skeleton — the DS-wide opt-in, so a caller never hand-rolls a placeholder.
- `meta.version` — The component's own semver, derived from its git history and stamped into the banner of the file you install.
- `meta.since` — The @interlace/ui release the component first shipped in.
- `meta.deprecated` — Present only when the item is on its way out. Carries `removedIn` (a real release, never "eventually") and `replacement`.
- `keyboard` — Observed evidence only. `baseUi` names the Base UI primitive that owns focus and dismissal; `keys` lists the UI Events key values this file branches on itself; `handled` is the disjunction. An item with handled:false is not asserted to be inaccessible — it is asserted to add no keyboard behaviour of its own.
- `states` — The string unions a caller has to satisfy, read from the source. Where a union is a precedence ladder (DATA_STATES) the array order IS the precedence, lowest index wins.
- `a11y` — ARIA roles and attributes written literally in the shipped file, plus whether it gates motion on prefers-reduced-motion and opts into the WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 focus ring.

Current distribution across the catalogue:

- rendering: 78 server, 59 client
- keyboard: 106 none, 31 handled
- built-in loading state: 30 of 137
- declared minViewport: 79 at 320, 7 at 480, 1 at 768, 50 at inherited

## Taxonomy

Two axes, both on every item. **Tier** is the DS layer (composition runs upward only). **Category** is intent.

- tier `primitive` — 62 item(s)
- tier `pattern` — 30 item(s)
- tier `effect` — 17 item(s)
- tier `template` — 13 item(s)
- tier `chart` — 6 item(s)
- tier `util` — 5 item(s)
- tier `starter` — 3 item(s)
- tier `theme` — 1 item(s)

- category `primitive` (Primitives) — 62 item(s)
- category `pattern` (Patterns) — 30 item(s)
- category `blog` (Blog & long-form) — 22 item(s)
- category `decorative` (Decorative) — 21 item(s)
- category `foundation` (Foundation) — 20 item(s)
- category `data` (Data display) — 18 item(s)
- category `effect` (Effects) — 17 item(s)
- category `form` (Form & input) — 15 item(s)
- category `template` (Templates) — 13 item(s)
- category `feedback` (Feedback) — 11 item(s)
- category `navigation` (Navigation) — 9 item(s)
- category `marketing` (Marketing) — 9 item(s)
- category `overlay` (Overlay) — 8 item(s)
- category `chart` (Charts) — 6 item(s)
- category `util` (Utilities) — 5 item(s)
- category `a11y` (A11y) — 4 item(s)
- category `starter` (Starters) — 3 item(s)
- category `theme` (Theme) — 1 item(s)

## Items — tier `theme`

- [Interlace Theme](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme): @interlace/ui — full DS CSS baseline: tokens, foundation (type/spacing/radius), preflight (focus ring + min-viewport contract), shadcn↔fumadocs bridge, and brand palette.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme.json`
  - contract: server, v1.8.0

## Items — tier `primitive`

- [Accordion](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/accordion): A disclosure stack is full-width by construction: the trigger row is `flex-1` with the chevron `shrink-0`, so headings wrap instead of clipping at 320px.

  - contract: client, min 320px, keyboard via Base UI accordion, v1.1.0

- [Aspect Ratio](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/aspect-ratio): Anatomy: a single block-level wrapper that reserves space by ratio (CSS `aspect-ratio`) and stretches to the parent's width. Use it as the *frame* for media that arrives async (images, video, embeds, charts) so the surrounding layout never shifts…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/aspect-ratio.json`

## Items — tier `chart`

- [Delta](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/delta): "It moved, this much, this way." The smallest complete unit of analysis and the most-repeated element in a dense view, so it is worth getting exactly right once.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/delta.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, states publish|release|action, v1.1.0
- [Metric Table](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/metric-table): The roic.ai row: metric name, values across time, sparkline, delta. Click a row to promote it into whatever chart the caller renders above.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/metric-table.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0
- [Network Graph](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/network-graph): Who is connected to whom, and who the network converges on.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/network-graph.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, keys ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowUp/End/Enter/Escape/Home/Space, v1.1.2
- [Series Table](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/series-table): The data behind a chart, as a real `<table>`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/series-table.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, states publish|release|action, v1.1.0
- [Sparkline](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sparkline): A trend in the width of a table cell. The densest thing in the package: it exists so a `MetricTable` row can show *shape* without spending a chart's worth of pixels, which is the whole roic.ai lesson — one row that reads a decade beats one chart that reads…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/sparkline.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, loading state, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0
- [Time Series](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/time-series): One metric over time, with the actions that moved it drawn ON the curve.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/time-series.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, keys ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/End/Escape/Home, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0

- [Animated List](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/animated-list): AnimatedList — reveals its children one at a time, newest on top, with a spring pop-in.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/animated-list.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Background Beams With Collision](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-beams-with-collision): Background Beams with Collision Component
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-beams-with-collision.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Background Gradient Animation](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-gradient-animation): BackgroundGradientAnimation — a decorative, animated multi-blob gradient surface (the "lava lamp" / aurora effect).
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-gradient-animation.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Background Lines](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-lines): @interlace/ui — background-lines (aceternity) (shadcn-compatible).
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-lines.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0

  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/border-beam.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0

  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/cloud-particles.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0
- [Flip Words](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/flip-words): FlipWords — an animated headline word that flips through a list, revealing each replacement letter-by-letter with a soft blur-and-rise.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/flip-words.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0
- [Focus Cards](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/focus-cards): Focus Cards — a responsive grid that spotlights one card at a time. Pointing at or keyboard-focusing a card keeps it sharp while every sibling dims and blurs, so the user's attention follows their cursor or focus ring.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/focus-cards.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Marquee](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/marquee): Marquee — WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide) compliant by default.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/marquee.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Number Ticker](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/number-ticker): NumberTicker - Performance Optimized
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/number-ticker.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0
- [Particles](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/particles): Particles — an ambient, token-driven particle field for hero and section backdrops. Decorative-only: `aria-hidden` and `pointer-events-none`, so it never reaches the accessibility tree or intercepts input.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/particles.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0

  - contract: server, v1.0.0

  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/spotlight.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Stars Background](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/stars-background): Meteors component - Aceternity-inspired falling meteor effect Uses pure CSS animations for optimal performance (no Framer Motion) Follows the project's CSS Animation Shift pattern
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/stars-background.json`

## Items — tier `starter`

- [A11y Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/a11y-starter): @interlace/ui — the three a11y primitives + the reduced-motion hook every consumer should install on day one.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/a11y-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.2
- [Layout Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/layout-starter): @interlace/ui — the six layout primitives that compose every page. One install, the LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY contract is satisfied.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/layout-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.2
- [MDX Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/mdx-starter): @interlace/ui — the components most MDX pipelines need (Callout, Prose, CodeBlock, Tag), wired through a default mdx-components.tsx.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/mdx-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.2

## Items — tier `util`

- [cn — class-name merge utility](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/cn): The DS type scale, as declared in `styles/foundation.css`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/cn.json`
  - contract: server, states h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|body|long|ui|ui-sm|caption|code, v1.1.0
- [No-flash theme bootstrap script](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme-script): A theme applied after hydration is a WHITE FLASH on every page load: the document paints `:root` (Interlace · light) first, React mounts, an effect reads localStorage, and only then does the page repaint into the dark or re-branded palette the user…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme-script.json`
  - contract: server, v1.0.1
- [Theme token manifest](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme-tokens): `THEME_TOKENS` enumerates every `--interlace-*` custom property a theme MUST define, for BOTH colour schemes. `THEMES` is the registry of themes that claim to satisfy it.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme-tokens.json`
  - contract: server, states primary|primary-hover|primary-active|primary-foreground|primary-subtle|primary-subtle-foreground|background|foreground|card|card-foreground|popover|popover-foreground|muted|muted-foreground|border|input|ring|accent|accent-foreground|secondary|secondary-foreground|destructive|destructive-foreground|success|success-foreground|warning|warning-foreground|info|info-foreground|caution|caution-foreground|scrim|scrim-foreground|hero-star|hero-trail|hero-meteor|hero-surface|hero-surface-deep|hero-foreground|window-control-close|window-control-minimize|window-control-zoom|chart-1|chart-2|chart-3|chart-4|chart-5|viz-grid|viz-axis|viz-edge|radius-sm|radius-md|radius-lg|brand-mark-bar-o|brand-mark-bar-g, v1.0.0
- [useReducedMotion hook](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/use-reduced-motion): Returns `true` when the user has `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` set.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/use-reduced-motion.json`
  - contract: client, v1.0.0
- [useTheme hook](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/use-theme): The runtime half of the two-axis theme contract. It owns the two pieces of state a user can change (which THEME, which SCHEME), persists them, and projects them onto `<html>` in exactly the shape `styles/index.css` expects:
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/use-theme.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
